hook_line: INDIA-PAKISTAN WORLD CUP CLASH DRAWS 8.4 MILLION TICKET REQUESTS

hook_stat.sub: Ticket requests for the India-Pakistan group match at the Wanderers

news_summary: The India-Pakistan group match on October 10, 2027 at the Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg has received 8,397,294 ticket requests, the ICC said, as total ballot requests passed 120 million.
payoff: Fans who do not register by November 21 will not be eligible to buy through the ballot once it closes.
